scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:server && npm run typecheck:scripts && npm run typecheck:relay && npm run typecheck:test && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.lint: wrangler types server/worker-configuration.d.ts >/dev/null && wrangler types test/worker-runtime.d.ts --include-env=false >/dev/null && oxlint --type-aware server/ scripts/ plugin/relay/ test/ web/ vitest.config.ts
scripts.format: oxfmt server/ scripts/ plugin/hooks/ plugin/relay/ plugin/tests/ plugin/types/ plugin/tsconfig.json test/ web/ vitest.config.ts
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check server/ scripts/ plugin/hooks/ plugin/relay/ plugin/tests/ plugin/types/ plugin/tsconfig.json test/ web/ vitest.config.ts
